entries.speaker: Confidant Abilities
entries.en: People you have formed a bond with have[n]special [clr 2]Confidant Abilities[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Confidant Abilities
entries.en: Your [clr 2]Confidant Rank[clr 27] indicates the strength[n]of your trust with someone. As this rank[n]increases, more of their Confidant Abilities[n]will be unlocked.

entries.speaker: Confidant Abilities
entries.en: Press [f 1 10 25] to open the menu, then select[n][clr 2]Confidant[clr 27]. From there, you can check each[n]Confidant's arcana, rank, and abilities.
